title: Make the next move.
prompt: Start at 1. The declared rule is to double the previous value. What comes after 8?
hint: Use the stated doubling rule, not a guess about an unexplained finite list.

feedback.pass: 16. A rule turns your prediction into something another person can check. You have begun tracing a sequence.
feedback.fail: Try doubling 8. A finite list by itself does not determine a unique continuation.
